# Gov311

> Gov311 is an independent community guide to government services, contacts, laws, and help. A source-checked guide names the person or tool that checked it against official sources. A draft has an incomplete check. A human review note tells you which detail to confirm with the office. Use the official links in each guide when you answer.

Find the person's city below, or start with the county if they live outside city limits. Each heading lists its parent guide sections. Read the entry for the office that runs the service or the body that adopted the law.

## United States federal government (us/_federal)

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/_federal/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Get your organization ready to apply for a federal grant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/_federal/services/apply-for-federal-grant.md): Before an organization can apply for a federal grant on Grants.gov, it must register in SAM.gov and set up a Grants.gov account. Registration is free and is not instant, so start early.
  - draft · Research by claude-code on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the county for a US street address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/_federal/services/find-the-county-for-an-address.md): Use the Census Geocoder to identify the county for a matched address, then check local boundaries if the parcel is near a city or county line.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Call 211 for local help with food, housing, and bills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/_federal/help/211.md): Dial 211 to talk with a person who can connect you to local help with food, housing, utility bills, and other needs. The call is confidential and the line answers 24 hours a day.
  - draft · Research by claude-code on 2026-11-21.
- [Find government benefits you may qualify for](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/_federal/help/benefit-finder.md): The USA.gov benefit finder asks a few questions and lists the government benefits you may qualify for, with instructions for applying to each one.
  - draft · Research by claude-code on 2026-11-21.

## State of Tennessee (us/tn/_state)

Parent guide sections, nearest first: United States federal government (us/_federal).

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Appeal a TennCare eligibility or medical decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/appeal-a-tenncare-decision.md): The notice tells you what TennCare decided. Use an eligibility appeal to challenge a decision about getting or keeping coverage. Use a medical appeal for a problem getting care through your plan.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Appeal a Tennessee property tax assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/appeal-property-assessment.md): Start with the assessor in the county where the property is located. If you disagree with the county board’s decision, the State Board of Equalization explains how to file a value appeal.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for a Tennessee Arts Commission grant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-arts-grant.md): The Tennessee Arts Commission publishes grant programs for artists and organizations. Each program has its own guidelines and application schedule.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for Families First cash assistance in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-families-first.md): Families First is Tennessee’s Temporary Assistance for Needy Families program. The Department of Human Services takes the application, interviews your household, and helps you prepare a plan before approval.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for Tennessee SNAP food benefits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-snap.md): The Tennessee Department of Human Services takes food assistance applications online, by mail, and at county offices. It screens some households for faster help based on need.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for Tennessee Promise and other state college aid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-state-college-aid.md): The Tennessee Higher Education Commission's student portal takes applications for Tennessee Promise and other state aid. Each program lists its own forms and deadlines.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for a job with Tennessee state government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-state-job.md): People who do not already work for the state can search the Department of Human Resources’ careers portal by agency, job title, or county and apply from the listing.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for TennCare health coverage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/apply-for-tenncare.md): Use TennCare Connect to apply for Tennessee Medicaid, check an application, or read a letter about your coverage. You can also apply by phone.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find Tennessee state contracts open for bids](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/bid-on-state-contracts.md): Use the Central Procurement Office’s supplier pages to find bid opportunities, check an event’s submission instructions, and register for a state contract award.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get help paying for child care in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/child-care-payment-assistance.md): The Department of Human Services explains which child care payment programs take applications or referrals and how to respond to a Smart Steps waitlist invitation.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find and claim unclaimed money in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/claim-unclaimed-property.md): Search the Tennessee Department of Treasury's records for money a business has turned over to the state, such as an old paycheck or bank balance. Searching and filing a claim are free.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [File a complaint about a Tennessee community or technical college](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-a-college-complaint.md): The Tennessee Board of Regents has a complaint process for its community colleges and Colleges of Applied Technology. Where you file depends on the school and the kind of concern.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Ask Tennessee Consumer Affairs for help with a business dispute](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-consumer-complaint.md): If you cannot resolve a purchase or service dispute with a business, the Attorney General's Division of Consumer Affairs can ask the business to respond and help both sides reach an agreement.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [File a discrimination complaint with the Tennessee Attorney General](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-discrimination-complaint.md): The Civil Rights Enforcement Division takes state discrimination complaints about work, housing, education, and places that serve the public. It now handles the work of the former Tennessee Human Rights Commission.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [File a complaint about a Tennessee bank, credit union, or lender](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-financial-institution-complaint.md): The Department of Financial Institutions handles complaints about financial institutions it regulates. Its Consumer Resources staff can help you identify the regulator for your account or loan.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [File for unemployment benefits in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-for-unemployment.md): File an unemployment insurance claim through Jobs4TN, check for messages about your claim, and certify each week you still need benefits.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a problem with care at a Tennessee hospital or nursing home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-health-facility-complaint.md): The Health Facilities Commission investigates complaints about care at health facilities. A complaint about an individual licensed health professional goes to the Department of Health.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [File a complaint about your Tennessee insurance policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-insurance-complaint.md): Consumer Insurance Services reviews complaints about insurers and agents, including disputed claims. The Department of Commerce and Insurance directs some kinds of coverage to a different office.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the right office for a Tennessee utility complaint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/file-utility-complaint.md): The route for a billing or service complaint depends on who regulates your utility. Start with the provider’s name as it appears on the bill.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a Tennessee county health department and clinic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-a-county-health-department.md): Find the clinic for your county, call about the service you need and check whether another location handles appointments for it.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Find the Tennessee board that licenses a profession](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-a-licensing-board.md): Look up the agency for a profession, find application and renewal instructions, or check an individual’s license. Tennessee has a separate lookup for health care professionals.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the property map for a Tennessee county](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-a-property-map.md): Search the Tennessee Property Viewer for parcels in 86 counties. For the other nine, it links to local sites, including KGIS for Knox County.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Find who handles a Tennessee residential building permit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-a-residential-permit-office.md): Check the address and municipality in the State Fire Marshal’s jurisdiction table before applying for a state residential building permit.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Find a Tennessee court case or the General Sessions clerk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-court-case.md): Use the county and division on a General Sessions notice to find the local clerk and docket. Use the statewide appellate search for a case in one of Tennessee’s three appellate courts.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Find a Tennessee legislative hearing, agenda, or floor vote](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-legislative-hearings.md): Use the committee named in a bill’s history to find its meeting, see which bills are on the agenda, and check what happened after the meeting.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a Tennessee parole hearing or ask about a decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/find-parole-hearing.md): The Board of Parole publishes hearing schedules and participation instructions. Families with questions about a person in state prison can ask a parole officer at that facility about the hearing or decision.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a municipal zoning amendment in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/follow-a-municipal-zoning-amendment.md): Find the hearing notice, compare the proposed zoning text or parcel map with the planning commission version, and check the council’s final action.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Form a Tennessee limited liability company](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/form-tennessee-llc.md): File articles of organization with the Secretary of State to create a new Tennessee LLC. The state provides an online filing system and instructions for filing on paper.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a certified copy of a Tennessee birth certificate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/get-a-birth-certificate.md): Request a certified birth certificate from a county health department or the Tennessee Office of Vital Records. The state also names its authorized online vendor.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Buy or reprint a Tennessee fishing license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/get-a-fishing-license.md): Use the Tennessee Wildlife Resources Agency's licensing system to buy a fishing license or print another copy. People who have held a Tennessee fishing license or registered a boat already have an account.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a Tennessee alcohol server permit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/get-alcohol-server-permit.md): The Alcoholic Beverage Commission issues individual permits for people who serve liquor, wine, or high-gravity beer at businesses licensed for on-premises consumption.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [How a bill becomes law in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/legislative-process.md): Follow a general bill through committee, the House and Senate, and the governor. Learn when to look for a public chapter and where to check its effective date.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Check whether a Tennessee property is on the National Register of Historic Places](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/look-up-historic-property.md): The Tennessee Historical Commission’s map and listing spreadsheet can help you find a historic property or district. Commission staff can check an address and explain how to propose a property for listing.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Make a WIC appointment in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/make-a-wic-appointment.md): A local WIC clinic takes applications for food and nutrition support during pregnancy, after birth, and for infants and young children. The Tennessee Department of Health lists clinics by county.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Read a Tennessee caption bill and find the amendments that passed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/read-a-caption-bill.md): A Tennessee bill can keep its number and title while an amendment replaces its contents. Use the House and Senate action histories to trace the change from the filed bill to the final act.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Read a Tennessee public chapter and find the law it changed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/read-a-public-chapter.md): Follow the code references in an enacted bill, identify which words changed, and check when each provision applies. A driver licensing law shows how to read the instructions.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find Tennessee’s state budget and agency spending proposals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/read-the-state-budget.md): Find the governor’s recommended budget, look up a department’s proposed funding, and trace what the General Assembly approved.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Register a charity before you ask for donations in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/register-charity.md): How a charitable organization registers with the Tennessee Secretary of State to solicit contributions and renews each year, and where the state publishes the fees, the renewal deadline, and who must register.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Register for Tennessee business tax](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/register-for-business-tax.md): The Department of Revenue takes state business tax registrations through TNTAP. Its guidance explains when a county or city clerk issues a separate business license.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Register to vote or update your Tennessee voter registration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/register-to-vote.md): Use the Secretary of State's online application or a paper form. If you moved, the right choice in the online application depends on whether you changed counties.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Title and register a vehicle after moving to Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/register-vehicle-after-moving.md): Your county clerk takes the application for a Tennessee title and license plate. The Department of Revenue lists the paperwork to bring, including what to do if a lender holds your title.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a pothole or debris on a Tennessee state road](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/report-a-state-road-problem.md): The Tennessee Department of Transportation takes maintenance requests for interstates and state routes. Use the road repair hotline or the online form to tell crews where the problem is.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report an injury at work in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/report-work-injury.md): Tell your supervisor about a work injury to start a workers’ compensation claim. The Bureau of Workers’ Compensation helps injured workers who have trouble with the process.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get Tennessee’s official travel guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/request-a-vacation-guide.md): The Tennessee Department of Tourist Development offers its vacation guide online and mails print copies on request.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a transcript or diploma from a Tennessee public high school](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/request-high-school-records.md): Ask the district where you attended high school for your records. Public charter schools handle their own requests, and Tennessee uses a separate service for high school equivalency records.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Schedule a school field trip to the Tennessee State Museum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/request-state-museum-field-trip.md): Teachers and school groups can request a guided visit to the Tennessee State Museum in Nashville. The museum’s scheduling office confirms the date and time.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Request a public record from a Tennessee state agency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/request-state-public-records.md): Find the records coordinator for the agency that holds the document. Its public records policy tells you how to inspect the record or ask for a copy.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Request a Tennessee criminal history check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/request-tennessee-background-check.md): The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation offers a name-based search of Tennessee criminal history records. Its public portal shows the fee and explains what the report covers.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Reserve a campsite at a Tennessee state park](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/reserve-state-park-campsite.md): Use the state parks reservation site to check your dates and choose a campsite. The individual park describes the types of sites it offers.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Look up Tennessee campaign donations and spending](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/search-campaign-finance.md): The Registry of Election Finance publishes filings from state candidates and political action committees. You can look up financial reports, contributions, and expenditures.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find and track pending bills in the Tennessee General Assembly](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/track-a-bill.md): Search the current or a past General Assembly, find both bill numbers, and read the latest action in each chamber. Use My Bills to follow proposals through the session.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Track a proposed amendment to the Tennessee Constitution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/track-a-constitutional-amendment.md): Follow a proposed constitutional change across two General Assemblies, find the text voters saw, and look up the statewide election result.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Transfer an out-of-state driver license to Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/transfer-driver-license.md): The Department of Safety and Homeland Security handles license transfers at full-service Driver Services Centers. You can start the application and have the department check your documents before you go.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Check a Tennessee contractor's license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/verify-contractor-license.md): Look up a contractor in the Department of Commerce and Insurance's public license search. The record shows license status, the expiration date, and any public disciplinary actions.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Arrange a visit to someone in a Tennessee state prison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/services/visit-someone-in-state-prison.md): Send the visitor application to the prison where the person is housed. Once approved, arrange a visit using that prison’s scheduling instructions.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find your Area Agency on Aging and Disability in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/aging-and-disability-assistance.md): The Department of Disability and Aging connects older adults, people with disabilities and family caregivers with regional offices. Staff can help you find local support, including meals.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Charitable Solicitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/charities-division.md): The state office that registers charitable organizations that ask the public for donations in Tennessee.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Tennessee Child Abuse Hotline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/child-abuse-hotline.md): The Department of Children’s Services takes reports of suspected child abuse or neglect in Tennessee. Its online reporting form is for situations that can wait for review.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Ask for an independent review of a Tennessee child welfare case](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/childrens-services-ombudsman.md): The Tennessee Commission on Children and Youth’s ombudsman helps resolve concerns about foster care, kinship care, and Child Protective Services cases.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report suspected misuse of Tennessee public money or property](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/comptroller-fraud-hotline.md): The Comptroller takes reports about fraud, waste, or abuse involving state agencies and local governments.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Tennessee field office for an environmental complaint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/environmental-field-offices.md): The Department of Environment and Conservation routes pollution concerns and permit questions to regional field offices. The field office map shows which office serves the area.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Tennessee Department of Human Services family assistance offices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/family-assistance.md): Find the office for your county to submit a food, cash, or child care assistance application and turn in documents.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

- [Ask the Tennessee Governor’s Office for help with a state agency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/governor-constituent-services.md): After you have tried to resolve an issue with the state agency that handles it, you can ask the Governor’s Office for help.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get help for a military family in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/military-family-readiness.md): The Tennessee Military Department’s family readiness staff connects service members, veterans, and families with help for military IDs, financial needs, and TRICARE questions.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a food safety problem at a Tennessee grocery store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/retail-food-safety.md): The Tennessee Department of Agriculture handles food safety complaints about grocery stores and convenience stores. Restaurant complaints go to the health department.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the right Tennessee government office](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/state-government-directory.md): Use Tennessee’s directory to reach a state department, contact a legislator, or find the city or county office that handles a local service.

- [Find a Tennessee veterans service officer for help with a claim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/contacts/veterans-service-offices.md): The Tennessee Department of Veterans Services lists state field offices and county service officers. You can make an appointment for help filing a veterans benefits claim.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Where to find Tennessee's landlord and tenant law](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/codes/renter-protections.md): Find the 17 counties covered by Tennessee’s Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act, where to read the law on repairs and eviction, and how to reach free legal help.

- [Where to find Tennessee state agency rules and proposed changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/codes/state-agency-rules.md): The Secretary of State publishes the official compilation of agency rules and the Administrative Register, where agencies publish notices and proposed changes.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Where to read the Tennessee Code and newly enacted laws](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/codes/tennessee-code.md): Use the Tennessee Code to look up a statute, a public chapter to read the change lawmakers enacted, or the private acts index for a law affecting one city or county.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find addiction treatment through the Tennessee REDLINE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/addiction-treatment-referrals.md): Call or text for a confidential referral to treatment for substance use or problem gambling. You can ask for help for yourself or a family member.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find outpatient mental health care through Tennessee’s Behavioral Health Safety Net](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/behavioral-health-safety-net.md): Adults looking for help paying for outpatient mental health care can ask a participating provider about Tennessee’s Behavioral Health Safety Net. Services include therapy and psychiatric medication management.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find shelter and recovery help after a Tennessee disaster](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/disaster-recovery.md): The Tennessee Emergency Management Authority lists shelters and directs people to help with housing, cleanup, and other needs after a disaster. Available programs depend on the event and location.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find rental housing or a housing voucher office in Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/find-rental-housing.md): Use Tennessee’s free rental search to look for an apartment. For help paying rent through a Housing Choice Voucher, check the agency that serves the area where you want to live.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Ask a lawyer a question online for free (TN Free Legal Answers)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/free-legal-answers.md): A website where Tennesseans who qualify can post a question about a civil legal problem and get a written answer from a volunteer lawyer at no cost.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find Tennessee help with starting a small business](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/_state/help/small-business-startup.md): The Department of Economic and Community Development publishes a startup guide covering registration, permits, financing, and business support.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

## City of Chattanooga (us/tn/chattanooga)

For county services, check which county contains the address. Choose one of these guide sections: Hamilton County, Tennessee (us/tn/hamilton-county) or Marion County, Tennessee (us/tn/marion-county).

Boundary under review for us/tn/marion-county. Check the parcel with the offices in the [boundary guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/chattanooga/services/reach-the-municipal-office.md) before using that county’s records.

Parent guide sections, nearest first: State of Tennessee (us/tn/_state) → United States federal government (us/_federal).

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/chattanooga/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Contact Chattanooga for local services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/chattanooga/services/reach-the-municipal-office.md): Find the municipal office, check who serves a street address and get to the county property records for land in Chattanooga.
  - draft · Research by codex on 2026-11-22.
  - Human review (conflicting evidence). Hamilton County is confirmed. UT’s municipal directory lists Hamilton and Marion. The Comptroller’s city-limit outline overlaps its Marion County outline along the county line, but the 2026 Census place and county polygons show Chattanooga only in Hamilton, as does the 2020 Census relationship file. The Comptroller’s recorded city changes for Chattanooga identify Hamilton. No controlling description establishing Marion jurisdiction for a specific parcel was located. For land on the Marion line, confirm the parcel and applicable annexation record with the assessor and city recorder before selecting a county office.
- [Report a missed Chattanooga garbage collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/chattanooga/services/report-a-missed-garbage-collection.md): Check the scheduled pickup and cart placement, then open a city service request.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.

## City of Ducktown (us/tn/ducktown)

Parent guide sections, nearest first: Polk County, Tennessee (us/tn/polk-county) → State of Tennessee (us/tn/_state) → United States federal government (us/_federal).

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Get the right business licenses for a Ducktown location](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/business-license.md): Ducktown levies a city business tax. Check your activity and receipts with Tennessee Revenue, then contact City Hall and the Polk County Clerk for the local licenses that apply.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for a Ducktown building permit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/get-building-permit.md): For a project inside Ducktown, call City Hall for the building inspector. Give the address and scope of work so the inspector can identify city permits, plan requirements, fees and occupancy approval.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Check a Ducktown city property tax bill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/property-tax-bill.md): Ask Ducktown City Hall about the city tax bill, the Polk County Trustee about the county bill, and the county property assessor about the property value used to calculate them.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Request Ducktown city records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/request-city-records.md): Ask the city recorder for an existing city record. Include the meeting date, subject or ordinance number, and say whether you want to inspect it or receive a copy.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find your Ducktown trash pickup or a county drop-off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/trash-collection.md): Call City Hall for your street’s pickup day and current charges. Polk County also accepts household trash from the county at its convenience centers.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Start water service or pay a utility bill in Ducktown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/services/water-and-sewer.md): Copper Basin Utility District handles Ducktown water and sewer. Call the district with your street address to check service or open an account. Existing customers can pay through the district's website.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Ducktown City Hall and city recorder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/contacts/city-hall.md): Call City Hall for city permits, Board of Commissioners meetings or city records. The clerk also serves as city recorder and keeps the ordinances and meeting minutes.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a proposed Ducktown ordinance and find the law that passed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/codes/city-ordinances.md): The Board of Commissioners reads an ordinance’s caption aloud. Get the full proposal from the city clerk, compare the version at the second reading and use the ordinance book to see what passed.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find Ducktown zoning and follow a proposed rezoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/ducktown/codes/zoning.md): Find a property on the city's planning map, read the rules for its district and check the planning commission's recommendation before following the final vote at City Hall.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

- [Report a street, drainage or greenway problem in Farragut](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/services/report-a-street-or-drainage-problem.md): Use the town’s citizen request form for a pothole, missing road sign or public drainage problem and give Public Works the location.

- [Request a Farragut town record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/services/request-town-records.md): Ask the recorder to inspect a record or receive a copy. The town has a form and email address for requests, and state law sets the response timetable.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Start water, sewer, gas or electric service in Farragut](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/services/start-water-gas-or-electric-service.md): Contact each utility serving the address. Farragut lists separate providers for water and sewer, electricity and natural gas.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the sheriff’s non-emergency line and fire service for Farragut](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/contacts/sheriff-and-fire-services.md): Use Knox 911’s directory for the correct sheriff’s line. Rural Metro is the subscription fire provider identified by the town.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Reach Farragut Town Hall and the town recorder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/contacts/town-hall.md): Find the town office for a permit, meeting or public record. Check the parcel’s county before choosing where to file land records or pay county taxes.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [How an ordinance becomes law in Farragut](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/farragut/codes/how-farragut-passes-an-ordinance.md): Check the board’s two votes, the final wording and the publication record. Tennessee’s mayor-aldermanic charter governs the town’s ordinance process.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

## Knox County, Tennessee (us/tn/knox-county)

Parent guide sections, nearest first: State of Tennessee (us/tn/_state) → United States federal government (us/_federal).

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Get a building permit in unincorporated Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/apply-for-a-building-permit.md): Check the permitting authority for your address, prepare your plans and look up inspections.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the right office in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/choose-a-county-office.md): Find county offices for deeds, vehicle records, elections and property questions, and check municipal boundaries for local services.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Take household trash, recycling or hazardous waste to the right facility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/drop-off-trash-and-hazardous-waste.md): Use Knox County convenience centers for eligible household loads. Check the separate Knoxville facility for household chemicals.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Enroll a student in Knox County Schools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/enroll-in-knox-county-schools.md): Enroll at the school assigned to the home address. Families without stable housing can get enrollment help even when records are missing.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a Knox County parcel in KGIS Maps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/find-a-parcel-in-kgis.md): Search by address, parcel ID or owner in KGIS. See school zones and political districts, then use the parcel ID to check the assessment, look up a tax bill or request a deed.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find which utility serves a Knox County address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/find-a-utility-provider.md): Electricity, gas, drinking water and sewer can come from different providers at the same address. Use the service type and parcel to identify the right district.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find an existing septic record or get a septic permit in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/find-septic-records-and-permits.md): Email the county health department for an existing system’s record. For a new installation, repair or remodel, call its Groundwater Protection office with the parcel and project details.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a Knox County charter amendment to the ballot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/follow-a-charter-amendment.md): Read the proposed charter language, find the public hearings and see what county voters decided.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Track a Knox County ordinance or resolution from proposal to vote](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/follow-a-county-commission-measure.md): Find pending measures, read what changed on the floor and get the recorded vote or adopted text from the County Clerk.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow or comment on a Knox County rezoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/follow-a-rezoning.md): Find a rezoning case by address or file number and read the conditions the County Commission voted to adopt.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a Knox County school board proposal, vote or current policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/follow-a-school-board-policy.md): Open the Board of Education’s dated agendas and minutes, then compare the action with the district’s published policy manual.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a Knox County governing body decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/follow-county-business.md): Find the regular meeting agenda, the source of the county’s authority and the record of what the governing body voted to adopt.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Get a Tennessee birth or death certificate in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/get-a-birth-or-death-certificate.md): The main health office issues both kinds of records. The West Clinic issues birth certificates only. Check the applicant and identification rules before visiting.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a Knox County business license or renew a minimal activity license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/get-a-business-license.md): Use the county clerk for the local license and Tennessee Revenue for a standard business tax return. Check whether the location also needs city registration.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a recorded deed, plat or easement for a Knox County parcel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/get-a-deed.md): Ask the Register of Deeds for recorded copies and use the county parcel lookup if all you have is a street address.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a Knox County Public Library card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/get-a-library-card.md): Knox County residents and property owners qualify for a free card. Bring the application and address documents to a library branch.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get a marriage license, book a courthouse wedding or request a copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/get-a-marriage-license.md): Start a license application online and finish with the county clerk. A ceremony is a separate appointment at the Old Courthouse.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Pay a Knox County property tax bill or question the assessed value](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/pay-or-question-property-tax.md): The trustee collects county taxes. The assessor handles valuation and the county Board of Equalization hears appeals. Knoxville also issues a city tax bill.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Read the Knox County budget](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/read-the-county-budget.md): Find the proposed and adopted county budgets and see when commissioners can change what gets funded.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a pothole, drainage problem or damaged county road](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/report-a-road-problem.md): Knox County Highway Maintenance handles county roads. Identify whether the road belongs to the county, Knoxville, Farragut or the state before reporting it.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a stray animal, animal welfare concern or suspected animal crime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/report-an-animal-problem.md): Young-Williams Animal Services handles routine animal control in Knox County and Knoxville. The Sheriff’s Office explains when law enforcement responds.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Request a Knox County government record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/request-county-government-records.md): Find the right county records coordinator and ask to inspect a record or get a copy.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Sign up for emergency notifications in Knox County, Tennessee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/sign-up-for-emergency-alerts.md): Use the county’s alert enrollment link to receive local warnings by text, email or phone. You can also sign up by phone.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Speak at a Knox County Commission meeting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/speak-at-a-commission-meeting.md): Register for public forum or speak to a specific agenda item. A county zoning hearing has its own testimony rules.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Title a vehicle or renew your tags in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/title-and-register-a-vehicle.md): Check the county clerk’s title checklist for how you acquired the vehicle. Renewal, transfer of ownership and a change of address have different filing steps.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find your Knox County ballot, polling place and election results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/services/vote-in-knox-county.md): Use your residence address to identify your Election Day location. Check the election-specific notice for early voting and the county archive for certified results.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Choose a Knox County Clerk branch for tags, licenses or copies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/contacts/county-clerk.md): Check which transactions the branch accepts before you travel. Driver license renewals and passport applications are available at selected offices.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Contact the Knox County Commission](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/contacts/county-commission.md): Find your district commissioner, the two at-large commissioners, meeting notices and the office that can send you a proposal.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Knox County court clerk named on your paperwork](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/contacts/court-clerks.md): Choose the clerk for a civil lawsuit, criminal or traffic case, juvenile matter or probate file. Several different courts use the City-County Building.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Knox County office for your address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/contacts/find-the-county-office.md): Check the city and county boundary before choosing a permit desk, tax office or road crew. A Knoxville mailing address can also serve unincorporated Knox County.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Knox County charter, ordinances and resolutions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/codes/county-charter-and-ordinances.md): Read the rules the County Commission uses to pass a law, what a reading means and how to check the effective date.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the zoning rules for a Knox County property](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/codes/county-zoning.md): Identify the parcel and its government, look up its current zoning, and check adopted changes before using a draft map.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Book a Knox County ride when the city bus route does not reach you](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/help/book-a-cac-transit-ride.md): CAC Transit schedules door-to-door rides for qualifying trips outside Knoxville Area Transit’s fixed-route coverage. A separate program can help riders who need assistance during an outing.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get help with an eviction or rental dispute in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/help/get-help-with-an-eviction.md): Find legal help anywhere in Knox County. The county’s eviction diversion application serves eligible renters living outside Knoxville and Farragut.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for energy bill assistance in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/help/get-help-with-utility-bills.md): Knoxville-Knox County Community Action Committee helps households apply for LIHEAP and describes a separate crisis option for the KUB service area.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Reach the Knox County WIC office](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/help/make-a-wic-appointment.md): Call the county WIC team to ask about eligibility, arrange an appointment and find out what to bring for the household.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for property tax relief or a senior tax freeze in Knox County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/knox-county/help/property-tax-relief-and-freeze.md): The trustee offers separate applications for property tax relief and a senior tax freeze. Check both if you own and occupy your home.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

Parent guide sections, nearest first: State of Tennessee (us/tn/_state) → United States federal government (us/_federal).

- [About this government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/jurisdiction.yaml): website, main contact, and parent government
- [Find the right office in Davidson County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/choose-a-county-office.md): Find county offices for deeds, vehicle records, elections and property questions, and check municipal boundaries for local services.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Find a Davidson County parcel in Nashville Parcel Viewer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/find-a-property-map.md): Look up a parcel’s owner, assessment history, zoning and permits. Use the parcel or address to check a Metro tax bill, find a council member or look up a school.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a Davidson County governing body decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/follow-county-business.md): Find the regular meeting agenda, the source of the county’s authority and the record of what the governing body voted to adopt.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Contact Nashville for local services](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/reach-the-municipal-office.md): Find the municipal office, check who serves a street address and get to the county property records for land in Nashville.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Get a residential building permit in Nashville](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/residential-building-permit.md): Homeowners can email a signed application and notarized affidavits to start a Nashville residential self-permit. After the required approvals, contact Permit Issuance to obtain the permit. Registered contractors can file through ePermits.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a proposed ordinance in Nashville](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/services/track-a-municipal-ordinance.md): Find the meeting, read the proposed language against the charter and code, and check the minutes and adopted text.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Metro Nashville Department of Codes and Building Safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/contacts/codes-department.md): The Metro department that issues building permits, answers zoning questions, inspects construction, and enforces property standards.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [hubNashville 311, Nashville's line for service requests and questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/contacts/hubnashville.md): hubNashville is the one place to request a Metro Nashville service, ask a question, or give feedback. You do not need to know which department handles your issue.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Where to find the building codes Metro Nashville enforces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/codes/building-codes.md): Points to Metro Nashville's official list of adopted building, residential, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and energy codes, the ordinance containing the local amendments, and the office that answers code questions.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Look up zoning rules for a Nashville property](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/codes/zoning.md): Nashville's zoning rules are in Title 17 of the Metro Code. The Davidson County Parcel Viewer shows the zoning district and overlays for any property.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Free legal help with an eviction in Nashville](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/nashville/help/eviction-legal-help.md): The Legal Aid Society offers free legal help to Davidson County renters who qualify, including a phone line for people facing eviction. Court deadlines are short, so call as soon as you receive a notice or court papers.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

- [Get a building permit outside Polk County’s city limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/build-in-unincorporated-polk.md): Apply in person at the county assessor’s office. Check the parcel first and arrange any separate septic, address and electrical approvals.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the right office in Polk County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/choose-a-county-office.md): Find county offices for deeds, vehicle records, elections and property questions, and check municipal boundaries for local services.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Get a recorded deed or plat in Polk County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/find-a-deed.md): The Register of Deeds in Benton keeps the recorded documents for land throughout the county, including its cities.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Polk County property map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/find-a-property-map.md): Search Polk County parcels by address, owner or parcel ID, check the assessment, and find the offices for tax bills, representation and school enrollment.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Follow a Polk County resolution from the agenda to the vote](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/follow-a-county-resolution.md): Find the next agenda, ask to speak, read the proposed resolution, and check the minutes for amendments and the vote.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a proposed or adopted Polk County school board policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/follow-a-school-board-policy.md): Use the district’s meeting packets for a proposed change and the board’s policy manual for the numbered policy it adopted.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Follow a Polk County governing body decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/follow-county-business.md): Find the regular meeting agenda, the source of the county’s authority and the record of what the governing body voted to adopt.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-22.
- [Get the local business license for a Polk County location](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/get-a-business-license.md): Start with the county clerk and check whether the city also issues a license. Tennessee Revenue explains which license applies to each business location.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Apply for a marriage license in Polk County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/get-a-marriage-license.md): Choose the Benton or Copper Basin clerk’s office and check what to bring. Tennessee law sets a specific rule for an applicant who is 17.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Look up a Polk County assessment or pay a property tax bill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/property-taxes.md): The assessor handles the parcel and value. The trustee collects county property taxes. A city may also send a bill.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Polk County budget, amendments and annual audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/read-a-county-budget.md): Compare the budget proposed for a fiscal year with the commission’s votes and the later audit of county finances.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Enroll a student in Polk County Schools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/register-a-student.md): Check the district’s registration instructions and contact the school about records, including what to do when a document is missing.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Report a pothole, blocked culvert or damaged sign on a Polk County road](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/report-a-road-problem.md): Reach the East or West Polk road crew and find the state reporting route for a Tennessee highway.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Take household trash to a Polk County convenience center](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/take-trash-to-a-convenience-center.md): Find the nearest county drop-off, check its hours and get the right authorization if your vehicle has out-of-county plates.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find your Polk County polling place, sample ballot or election result](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/services/vote-in-polk-county.md): Use the county election office for registration changes, precincts, local ballot notices and results in Benton, Copperhill, Ducktown and unincorporated Polk County.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Reach the Polk County Clerk in Benton or Copperhill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/contacts/county-clerk.md): Get vehicle tags and titles, marriage licenses and business license information, or request a County Commission record.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.

Benton, Copperhill and Ducktown also have city offices, and several county services have a second location in the Copper Basin.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find the Polk County clerk for a court case, probate or jury service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/contacts/court-clerks.md): The Clerk of Court and the Chancery Clerk and Master work in different buildings in Benton. The court named on your paperwork tells you which one to call.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Reach the Polk County Health Department in Benton or Copperhill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/contacts/health-department.md): Contact a local public health office about appointments, family services and referrals, including WIC.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Contact the Polk County Sheriff for a non-emergency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/contacts/sheriff.md): Find the county reporting number, the Benton office and the Copper Basin office.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Find a Tennessee private act that applies to Polk County](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/codes/polk-private-acts.md): Trace a bill about Polk County through the General Assembly, read the private chapter and check whether it needed local approval.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Check Polk County subdivision and floodplain rules before splitting land](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/codes/subdivision-and-floodplain.md): Find out which planning commission has the parcel, get the rules and meeting agenda, and check who signs the final plat before recording.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
- [Get help after the November 2026 Polk County flood](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/appalachios/gov311/main/data/us/tn/polk-county/help/november-2026-flood-recovery.md): Report local damage, find Tennessee’s household and small-business applications, and check federal disaster loan options for the November 5 flooding.
  - source-checked · Checked by codex on 2026-11-21.
